title: THE GOD WHO GOES BEFORE YOU

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The Lord your God himself will cross over ahead of you. He will destroy these nations before you, and you will take possession of their land. Joshua also will cross over ahead of you, as the Lord said. And the Lord will do to them what he did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, whom he destroyed along with their land." — Deut 31:3-4 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses reassures the people that though he is leaving, God is not. "The Lord your God himself will cross over ahead of you." The most important leader was never Moses — it was always the Lord. He would go before them into the land, clearing the way, just as He had already defeated the kings Sihon and Og. Joshua would lead, but God would go first.

What a steadying truth for anyone facing an uncertain future. Whatever "Jordan" lies ahead of you — a new season, a daunting challenge, an unknown road — God goes before you. You are not the first one into the battle. He has already gone ahead. He is not sending you somewhere He is unwilling to go Himself.

Moses also grounds their confidence in the past: "what he did to Sihon and Og." Remembered victories build present courage. Because God had proven Himself faithful before, they could trust Him for what lay ahead. God's track record is our reason for confidence.

This is beautifully fulfilled in Christ, our forerunner who has "entered on our behalf" ahead of us (Heb 6:20). He has gone before us through death itself and into the Father's presence, opening the way. Whatever you face, you follow a God who has already gone ahead of you. Step forward not in fear but in faith, knowing the One who leads you has already secured the ground. He goes before you still.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What "Jordan" am I facing that I need to trust God to go before me?
2. How do God's past faithfulness and victories build my courage now?
3. What would change if I truly believed God goes ahead of me?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You go before me into every challenge I face. I am never the first into the battle, for You have already gone ahead. Give me courage to follow You in faith. Amen.
